Stations
Kensington Olympia
Kensington Olympia ( KPA )
Kensington Olympia station, Olympia Way, Kensington, Greater London, W14 0NE
Open in Google Maps (external link, opens in a new tab)
Station managed by London Overground
Un-booked assistance? No problem.
This station offers assistance to customers who have not pre-booked any passenger assistance. We recognise that some customers already travel without having pre-booked assistance. Assistance can still be pre-booked for travel from/to this station
Transport links Tube, Metro and Tram links Bus Airport View live departures and arrivals

Platform facilities
The platforms are level with the Main Entrance of the station
There are tactile warnings on all platforms in use
How busy is the station?
Usually, the following passenger levels are expected at this station. Events, seasonal trends and disruption can make the station busier than normal.
We use historic travel patterns to determine how busy a station is expected to be. Find out how expected station passenger levels are calculated.
